description: Linux kernel module source code for uboot environment in RAM, implementing device driver functions for reading, writing, and managing uboot environment data stored in reserved memory.

methods.name: to_ubootenv_drvdata
methods.description: Converts a file pointer to ubootenv_drvdata structure.

methods.name: ubootenv_write
methods.description: Handles writing data to uboot environment.

methods.name: ubootenv_read
methods.description: Handles reading data from uboot environment.

methods.name: ubootenv_llseek
methods.description: Handles seeking within uboot environment data.

methods.name: ubootenv_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for uboot environment.

methods.name: ubootenv_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver when the device is detected.

methods.name: ubootenv_remove
methods.description: Cleans up when the device is removed.
